args.title: Elevated error rate affecting canary 0.2.0-waitlist and stable 0.1.0-m2 at 5% traffic

args.reason: The numbers show stable(0.1.0-m2) is also failing with an error rate of 1.000 alongside the canary; investigate shared upstream dependencies, network, or database rather than rolling back the canary.

parts.text: I propose holding because the 100% error rate affects both the canary and stable versions equally, indicating a shared infrastructure or upstream issue rather than a canary regression.
